_about: OUR catalogue's numbers for the brand and category page texts — FIXED numbers, printed by `php artisan seo:seed-texts` and changed only by a recount. Written by `php artisan seo:count-facts --write`; do not edit by hand. The brands' OWN figures are in brand_sources.json.
counted_from: database `u591083448_eleganceeg`; its newest catalogue product was added on 2026-11-05

method.models: Every real catalogue product the page lists on that storefront, IN STOCK OR NOT: the page's own listing (the same query its storefront request runs) without the in-stock filter. This is the largest real number of models the shop carries there; what is in stock today is a smaller number and is not recorded.
method.category_total: A category's `models` is the SUM of its brands' counts (`brands[].count`). `listed` is the listing's own total; the two differ only if a product of that category has no brand.
method.types_brands: A brand page: the kinds of product the brand has on that storefront (the category tree below its top level), with the number of models in each. A category page: its brands, with the number of models of each.
method.movements_colors_materials: The listing's own facets over the same products: each value with the number of models that carry it, most models first.
method.price: The lowest and the highest price among the same products, in EGP, as the listing reports them (a sale price counts when the product is on sale).
method.refresh: php artisan seo:count-facts (dry run: shows what changed) then php artisan seo:count-facts --write; then php artisan seo:seed-texts --storefront=<code> --overwrite --apply for each storefront.
